headlines.text: Back on this day in 2022, Katsuyori Shibata made their AEW debut against Orange Cassidy, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.64 ? a strong outing. A dream match Shibata personally requested ? with Mike Tyson on commentary ? ended with two Orange Punches, but Cassidy capped it by handing Shibata his signature sunglasses in a show of respect.
